workflow_synthesis.evidence_axis: G_distribution: adaptive source-diverse near-boundary bracketing implementation
workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: tests whether deterministic bracket refinement can populate the strict primary low-margin band after M811 fixed-grid miss
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: no-training corpus implementation only; no residual calibration PPO or driver promotion
stop_condition: stop if accepted rows are absent
stop if accepted rows are source concentrated
stop if accepted rows are boundary-axis concentrated
stop if bracket refinement is nonmonotone or artifact-dominated
stop if actor or residual checksums change
fallback_plan: if bracket refinement is sparse, audit before another data route
if refinement is two-axis only, audit before calibration
if nonmonotone behavior dominates, pivot to source-route or simulator-fidelity planning
if corpus passes, route to audit before any residual calibration
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M814 implements the adaptive bracketing design from M813

hypothesis: Adaptive closed-loop bracketing can resolve M811 collision/safe edges into source-diverse primary low-margin rows without weakening thresholds or training parameters.
success_criteria: M814 writes source bracket refinement accepted intervention balance limitations progress summary and documentation artifacts

implementation omits source warm-up fault or axis diversity diagnostics
